author: PC Gamer
text:
3 months after launch, Riot announces League of Legends Classic will be killed in January: 'most have gone back to other parts of League'
New Champions will continue to roll out for now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
State lawsuits accuse OpenAI of ignoring its own safety warnings for profit: 'All these harms were foreseeable and avoidable'
Several US states have sued the company, alleging that ChatGPT is harming the public.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ex-Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan ignores everything about the hero shooter after his 'almost clinical' departure 5 years ago: 'I don't search for my name in Overwatch. I don't search for Overwatch. I sort of just disconnect.'
The former Blizzard developer has moved on.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I want to love the new Castlevania, but it just feels a little off
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse has the right pieces for a grand revival, but it hasn't quite nailed the assembly.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'My idea of a Netflix for games doesn’t work': Garry's Mod successor is getting 'sweeping changes'
"I’m sorry—we are going to do better."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Legendary composer Frank Klepacki says the RTS genre isn't dead, but he would like to see devs get a little more creative with it
Klepacki shared his thoughts on the state of the real-time strategy genre in the latest issue of Edge.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 leaker threatens Take-Two with a 'dead man's switch'
Cyberleek promises not to reveal the ending of GTA 6, as long as Take-Two leaves them alone.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ace Combat Zero gets its own standalone app on Steam, freeing it from the 136GB install of Ace Combat 8
The biggest complaint about the pre-order bonus game is getting resolved with a happy ending.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I've given GTA 5's cars Bond-style ejector seats
Going up.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Looking back on 10 years of Overwatch, the promises kept, and where Team 4 goes from here
"In order for people to play the game in the present, they need to have confidence in its future."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Walking Dead's Chandler Riggs made a Resident Evil 7 short film even though 'it's impossible to please everybody'
We're swamped with Resident Evil films right now, lucky us.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced was a big hit, and now it's time for big layoffs at the studio that made it
Ubisoft has also decided to close Trials studio Ubisoft Redlynx entirely.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hogwarts Legacy's DLSS 5 update shows devs have been listening to PC gamers about keeping it the hell away from game characters
Nvidia's DLSS 5 is getting smaller in practically every way, including the performance overhead and the AI yassification.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'AI godfather' worries we're creating 'alien beings' with artificial intelligence, with pesky moral implications
"We should care as much about all the other aspects of a being as you do about its intelligence."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Looks like a lighter, carbon fibre version of the best gaming mouse I've held is on its way, but don't look at the price tag
Hopefully it's a currency/market quirk.

author: PC Gamer
text:
If New Blood had made Dusk 2, there'd be no Iron Lung, 'and now David Szymanski has got a movie that made $50 million'—so maybe there's wisdom in not churning out sequels
You don't need to milk your cash cows.

author: PC Gamer
text:
WoW: Forever has a new kind of ban to deal with real money trading
Time isn't money, friend.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Doom can 'run' on a DNS database now, and one of the technology's pioneers says 'I can't decide whether this is deliciously horrible, or else horribly delicious'
Apparently the database is acting a bit like a "librarian" and not doing the actual compute.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fortnite is coming to Linux once Epic improves Easy Anti-Cheat
A major shooter is pushing past the Linux anticheat barrier.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Epic says its new 'vibe coded' Epic Games Store launcher is faster than Steam
The updated version is in beta for the time being, and represents a total rebuild of the EGS client.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' PvE test is finally here and it's the perfect reason to jump back in
This is exactly what Arc Raiders needs right now.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6 was delayed partially because the amount of NPCs was 'horrifying' and required a dedicated studio full of writers to handle
"We [could have] hit that schedule, but it won’t be the game we want to make."

author: PC Gamer
text:
OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly using AI and toilet paper to record confidential meetings - FBI director Kash Patel jumps at the chance to say AI companies are 'essential' for national security
AI and toilet paper: the joke writes itself, doesn't it?

author: PC Gamer
text:
'123456' password was all a hacker reportedly needed to expose over 8 million people's personal data
A department where just a little bit of creativity doesn't go amiss.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Haunted Chocolatier is still 'a town game', but it'll be more of an action RPG: 'It's for the people in Stardew Valley that go into the mines'
Farming dungeons, not gourds.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I just tricked DLSS into running on my AMD GPU in Cyberpunk 2077 and Alan Wake 2 and all it took was running a single script
It's easy enough to install, so worth a try, I'd say.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam's new Big Art Mode is a lovely visual upgrade for my living room setup
Big Art Mode is looking fiiiine.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam now has a maddening bouncing logo screensaver, and I'm pretty sure it doesn't perfectly hit the corners
It sucks, get rid of it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve is clearing out its discontinued Index VR headsets if you want a cheap piece of history
The Steam Frame has rendered the tethered workhorse obsolete.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser says he 'failed' with Max Payne 3, and I'm sorry Danno but that's just plain wrong
Hear me out.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Less than 2 weeks after announcing RuneScape Reignited, Jagex is scrapping the whole thing
In the wake of a furious backlash from players, Jagex admits it "missed the mark."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valheim vs Enshrouded vs RuneScape: Dragonwilds: Let's settle this
Three top-tier survival crafting games have entered their 1.0 era.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Street Fighter review roundup: sorry, folks, but it sounds like a mess
The general consensus seems to be that Street Fighter isn't a disaster, but it definitely misses a lot more than it hits.

author: PC Gamer
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever devs say gear upgrades will stay relevant 'for a long, long time': 'It's very much our intention to try wherever we can to not invalidate old content'
Blizzard says items won't work like the modern version of the MMO.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Control Resonant sells 1 million copies in 3 weeks to become Remedy's fastest-selling game ever
It's not a huge number, but it's big news for Remedy.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 5 finally measures up to the actual best GTA game now I've added a jetpack
Zoom.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Come on Razer what are you doing? This Pokemon-themed mouse is most definitely not the one
Now listen, I'm no designer, but...

author: PC Gamer
text:
The AI bubble may not have burst yet, but $1 trillion worth of air appears to have escaped
Not so much 'going out with a bang' as 'anticlimactic party balloon deflation'.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Shogun 2 remaster is so bad, Sega is removing it from sale and bringing back the original
Sega admits Shogun 2 - Complete Edition "has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards," so it's going back to the drawing board.

author: PC Gamer
text:
79% of you think Razer's new gaming mouse feature counts as cheating
I doubt it will do a 180, though. Hey-hey!

author: PC Gamer
text:
It's taken its sweet time, but Intel's response to AMD's X3D chips is starting to look tasty
A 65 W Ultra 9 Nova Lake chip with BLLC is reportedly on the way.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I jammed Nvidia's new DLSS 5 October update model into the RTX Spark and it's 25% faster at 1440p
The performance hit you get from enabling DLSS Neural Rendering is now significantly lower, but NBA 2K27 is still not going to convince anyone.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Where to find the Takashiro region Treasure Hunt in Forza Horizon 6
Track this chest to a field of long grass.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Finally: Our favorite roguelike for sickos will let me play as a sapient tree
Diaspora, Caves of Qud's first expansion, enters early access in December.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Razer Wolverine V4 Pro wireless gaming controller review
Claws, sharpened.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Grand Theft Auto 6 launch trailer is here
This one's got a very different vibe than what we've seen previously.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nvidia's RTX Spark makes for an impressive Arm-based gaming laptop but not one I'd recommend you buy just for PC gaming
The performance is there, the experience is great, but the price is utterly punitive when you compare against dedicated gaming laptops.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Epic said its game launcher was faster than Steam on the same day Steam got a speed boost—so I've put both to the test
There's only seconds in it, mind.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After Civ 7 stumbled, Humankind 2 looks like it's making smart choices to pick up the 4X torch
Very dialectical.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 review
How much are an OLED screen, TMR sticks, and a fresh aesthetic worth to you?

author: PC Gamer
text:
A co-op survival game where trolls aren't just there to be killed? 'We don't talk about them as enemies, but rather as neighbors'
What kind of neighbor will you be in Trollheim: Gnomes?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Xbox Ally X 20 vs Xbox Ally X: A wickedly bright OLED screen and frosty temps make for a begrudgingly attractive upgrade for the Asus handheld
All that glitters might actually be gold.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'There is no secret sauce' to a successful live service game according to Overwatch's associate game director, but knowing your audience is a good start
"We occupy this really unique spot in the middle."

author: PC Gamer
text:
OLED really is the gift that keeps on giving, with what should be cheaper 700 Hz panels planned by TCL for 2028
'Cheap' being a relative term, of course.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Big Walk devs explain why it isn't on Xbox and likely never will be, 'not until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets'
"We've made this decision with the belief that meaningful change can be made in the world."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Disco Elysium splinter studio's Red Rooster is going to be a 'an incendiary, physics-driven RPG' where you play an inmate, an opiate-fuelled mathematician, and a bus driver with nunchucks
Setting the world on fire.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve is toying with a Steam Frame OLED and some Reddit users are already wondering whether to wait an excruciatingly long time for it even though it may never happen
Gluttons for punishment.

author: PC Gamer
text:
How in the world are Intel GPUs still improving so much? The latest driver update claims up to a 31% fps improvement in Resident Evil Requiem
And more modest but still significant boosts in other games.
